event.text: Starting with memory for L-108, since earlier incidents may change the plan.

call.name: recall_memory
cypher:
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIED]->(l:Lot {code: $lot})
OPTIONAL MATCH (l)-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT pl.sku) AS skus
WITH s, [(p:Product)-[:SHIPPED_UNTRACKED]->(a:Store) WHERE p.sku IN skus | a.id]
       + [(q:ProductLot)-[:SHIPPED_TO]->(b:Store) WHERE q.sku IN skus | b.id] AS stores
MATCH (m:Memory)-[:ABOUT]->(x)
WHERE m.lot <> $lot AND (x = s OR (x:Store AND x.id IN stores))
RETURN m.lot AS from_lot, m.at AS at, labels(x)[0] AS kind, x.id AS about, m.fact AS fact
ORDER BY at DESC, about LIMIT 20

call.name: propose_classification

input.rationale: Undeclared sesame, a major allergen, in chilled ready-to-eat food can cause anaphylaxis, and product already on shelves means the public must be told.

call.summary: Proposed Class I, consumer-level recall. Awaiting confirmation
cypher:
MERGE (i:Incident {lot: $lot})
ON CREATE SET i.id = $id, i.reported_at = $at, i.hazard = 'not recorded'
SET i.class = $class, i.depth = $depth, i.rationale = $rationale, i.classified_at = $at
RETURN i.id AS id, i.hazard AS hazard

call.name: trace_forward
cypher:
MATCH path = (l:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED|SHIPPED_TO*1..8]->(st:Store)
RETURN st.id AS store,
       [n IN nodes(path) | coalesce(n.code, n.id)] AS path,
       [n IN nodes(path) | labels(n)[0]] AS kinds,
       last(relationships(path)).units AS units

call.name: place_hold
call.summary: 0 units and 202 kg of raw L-108 held at 1 location
cypher:
MATCH (l:Lot {code: $lot})-[s:STORED_AT]->(site:Site)
RETURN site.id AS id, site.name AS name, site.city AS city, site.region AS region, s.qty_kg AS qty_kg, l.received_kg AS received_kg

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)-[h:HELD_AT]->(loc)
WITH DISTINCT pl, h, loc
MATCH (pl)-[:OF]->(p:Product)
RETURN pl.id AS product_lot, p.name AS product, labels(loc)[0] AS kind, loc.id AS id, loc.name AS name,
       loc.city AS city, loc.region AS region, h.units AS units
ORDER BY kind, id, product_lot

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(:ProductLot)-[h:HELD_AT]->()
SET h.held_for = $lot, h.held_at = $at

event.text: The hold covers all 202 kg received, and the trace shows the lot was never used in any batch or store—so the remaining chokepoint, gap, backward-check, and notice steps can be skipped. I'll record a recall scope of zero stores.

call.name: minimal_recall
cypher:
MATCH path = (l:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED|SHIPPED_TO*1..8]->(st:Store)
RETURN st.id AS store,
       [n IN nodes(path) | coalesce(n.code, n.id)] AS path,
       [n IN nodes(path) | labels(n)[0]] AS kinds,
       last(relationships(path)).units AS units

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)
WITH collect(DISTINCT pl.sku) AS skus
MATCH (p:Product)-[u:SHIPPED_UNTRACKED]->(st:Store)
WHERE p.sku IN skus
RETURN st.id AS store, p.sku AS sku, p.name AS product, u.units AS units, u.shipped_at AS shipped_at

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)
WITH collect(DISTINCT pl.sku) AS skus
MATCH (pl2:ProductLot)-[:SHIPPED_TO]->(st:Store)
WHERE pl2.sku IN skus
RETURN st.id AS store, collect(DISTINCT pl2.id) AS received_lots

call.name: record_lessons

lessons.fact: Riverbend Herbs lot L-108 (mushroom) carried undeclared sesame from allergen cross-contact on the supplier's line, reported 2026-10-18.
Northfield Plant 1 had received all 202 kg of L-108 and none of it had gone into any batch when the hold was placed, so nothing shipped.

cypher:
UNWIND $lessons AS lesson
MATCH (x {id: lesson.about}) WHERE x:Supplier OR x:Store OR x:Batch OR x:Site OR x:DC
CREATE (m:Memory {lot: $lot, fact: lesson.fact, at: $at})-[:ABOUT]->(x)
RETURN labels(x)[0] AS kind, x.id AS about, m.fact AS fact

result.summary: No store needs a recall for lot L-108: the mushroom from Riverbend Herbs that carried undeclared sesame was never used. I proposed Class I at consumer depth because a major allergen in ready-to-eat food can cause severe reactions, though in practice nothing reached the public. All 202 kg delivered to Northfield Plant 1 are now on hold, and no batch, product lot or store was made from or received any of it. There was no earlier memory about this supplier, so nothing changed my plan, and there was no chokepoint to rank or gap store to ask about. I skipped the backward check and the notices because there were no cleared stores and no stores to recall. The recall scope is 0 stores (blanket, targeted and cleared all 0) and 0 units to pull, and I saved lessons about the supplier and the plant. The coordinator still needs to confirm the class, decide what happens to the held lot and authorise its release; I haven't approved, sent or released anything.
